title_cyr: Бој се бие на Пирин планина
title_latin: Boj se bie na Pirin planina
title_en: A battle is fought on Pirin mountain
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional-style song, origin unclear. 'Го мие' and 'го реди' refer to the head of Stojan (my reading); 'реди' could also mean 'arranges' as in preparing the dead.

lines.cyr: Бој се бие на Пирин планина,
lines.lat: Boj se bie na Pirin planina,
lines.en: A battle is fought on Pirin mountain,

lines.cyr: та се бијат три дни и три ноќи.
lines.lat: ta se bijat tri dni i tri noḱi.
lines.en: they fight for three days and three nights.

lines.cyr: Та го дочула старата му мајка,
lines.lat: Ta go dočula starata mu majka,
lines.en: His old mother heard of it,
and went to the river Vardar.

lines.cyr: Ем го мие, ем го мие ли,
lines.lat: Em go mie, em go mie li,
lines.en: She washes it, she washes it,
and sadly lays it out, oh!
